novelty_flags.label: Proposition common-shock-boundary
novelty_flags.one_line: Its impossibility claim says “no unchanged within-network HAC” can recover the component, but names no specific published estimator or bibkey that the boundary refutes.

soundness_flags.label: Definition common-shock-witness / Proposition common-shock-boundary
soundness_flags.one_line: The relation m_i=τ_P+Q/√n cannot hold for every n on the proposal’s single compatible infinite-volume law P; state an explicit triangular sequence (P_n,m_{n,i}) outside 𝔓 or reformulate the boundary.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem hac-exactness and Theorem uniform-wald
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Their conclusions remain conditional on an affirmative resolution of Open-ended Question endogenous-random-metric; the four-root random-metric implication is not yet established.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact unchanged graph-HAC and uniform Wald coverage under 𝔓, conditional on the affirmative random-metric quadratic result.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract, lines 75–79; journal metadata, lines 15–20 and 334–336
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article studies randomized network interference under ANI and reports that its network-HAC estimator is biased under a finite-population model, with bias interpretable as unit-level exposure-effect variance.

Theorem 4.2 requires network exogeneity plus stated path-distance/CLT conditions; Remark 4.3 says exogeneity ensures zero conditional covariance for disconnected agents and explains resulting network-HAC bias without it.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author preprint corresponding to Journal of Econometrics 222(2), 2021
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 10, Assumption 2.1 and discussion of sums centered by E[Y_{n,i}|C_n]; p. 24, Proposition 4.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The inspected version formulates conditional ψ-dependence and proves HAC consistency for its conditionally centered covariance target under Assumptions 2.1 and 4.1.

source_verification_receipts.version: March 2022 author version corresponding to Annals of Statistics 50(4), 2022

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a graphon population-target limit with an additional interference variance term and explains that its available standard plug-in estimator does not estimate the full interference-adjusted variance.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2309.07476v3, 5 June 2025, corresponding to the cited Journal of Econometrics article
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1 abstract; p. 3 introduction; Appendix B, Lemma B.3 and Theorem 3.2 proof
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies design-based network-HAC anti-conservativeness under nonconstant effects and proposes an adjusted conservative covariance estimator; its proof invokes KMS for a conditionally centered HAC step.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rewrite the common-shock boundary as a stationary nonergodic triangular sequence P_n with m_{n,i}=τ_n+Q/√n, and explicitly identify Leung2022ANI’s sample-centered graph-HAC as the estimator that fails there.
Add uniform-probability versions of the bandwidth-tail, bandwidth-growth, and Følner-boundary conditions, or weaken the three uniform conclusions to pointwise-in-P results.

Make the random-metric OEQ sharper by naming an endpoint-influence defect functional and proving either its vanishing criterion or a concrete nondegenerate counterexample with persistent selection bias.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: repair the triangular common-shock boundary and anchor its impossibility claim to a named published HAC estimator; retain the conditional random-metric headline.
